content: Juán Bautístabay tu̱chodara Ju̱denu niquejada mityatomu
Variryundamu ji̱ta su̱deda Juán Bautístabay tu̱chu̱ Judéya mityatomu.
Saniquejada ji̱ta: “Jirya̱paru̱y riva va̱cha jachipiya̱jada, jiryatiy ratuudiñuma Jarichumuvichi̱ nusu̱yada nijya̱nvay jachipiya̱jadamu.”
Juán Bautístabaynchiy ji̱ta satu̱choda Ju̱denuju̱ tu̱chu̱bay Isayíyasiy jtyati̱bay, jiryatiy saniquejada:

content.text: “Ti̱ jtani̱te natuye̱ tajityomudaque: Ya̱numa jdutya ji̱tyaju̱ra nú̱ Vu̱ntyityu̱jiju̱, vasenú̱ ya̱barya nú̱ sa̱jiju̱.”

content: Juánbay ji̱ta jachodara jasi̱jasityera jvaachara jichujay yiva, caméllujasityera jvaachara. Sapuchoda ji̱tara jicyannujay caméllu jatyera. Si̱myisi̱ ji̱ta vichanu̱yada vindya ruvá, to quisijya̱ jarye sisa̱ju̱.
Jadchiy ji̱ta ru̱deda nijya̱nvay simu Juánbay Jerusarí̱ ja̱nvavyedabay, Judéya mucadija̱nvavyedabay ruusa̱ju̱, Jurdá̱ja̱ ju̱ro̱ vichavabe jarye ti̱ta̱ju̱.
Riityu̱ñu̱yada ji̱ta simu Juánbay Jurdá̱ja̱mu riñiquejadanumatiy vijyo̱mujachera jijyuuchuveda variy.

Sadiyadanumatiy Juánbay ruuva rajuuvay Varyisévuveda tevabe, Saadusévuveda tevabe jarye ruusa̱ju̱, jiryatiy ruuti̱tityiyada rirya̱tidye jtyu̱y variy simu, su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: “Codityevay rapu̱ryamiy, ¿chi̱ra datyadosiy ji̱tyaju̱ jirye, chi̱? ¡Jirya̱numa bay ra̱jisiy Ju̱denu nique̱yada!
Daryatiy rajontay ni̱nu, darya jirya̱jontay samirya vicha̱damuju̱ntidye, jirya̱tidye dityanu ratara va̱cha jvaayadiva paru̱yada.

Ne jirya̱jachipiya̱ jivyimu: Avurá̱bay ji̱ta vu̱myunatyi̱, ramutiy sa̱jantyuy Ju̱denu vuryiva. Ri̱tatye ji̱ta jiryiva: Saryi ju̱de Ju̱denu jiñu ravichu̱musiy Avurá̱bay dadyeñuju̱ rityidye ra̱tuva̱chu variy simu.

Netimyu̱ ne jirya̱jontay samirya vicha̱damuju̱, jirya̱ma̱ datya: Ni̱nu ruva̱tuununumara jaseé, ru̱nusa̱daju̱. Ramuni̱day rirya̱jnura jirya ni̱nuvicha̱ jiryatimyu̱ ne samirya jorara, rirya̱tidye jatya jiidamyu variy rivara.

Ray ji̱ta jtyanu ja̱a̱ta jirye, jirya̱tidye dityanu ratara jiryepyaru̱yada riva va̱cha jachipiya̱jada. Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta jiryatiy sa̱jti̱ ri̱bivaju̱ savichasara jaryi datyara rimusidye. Ne vinu sasaapatu jtodasa̱ra̱ ntate darye. Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta ra̱jtyanu Ju̱denu Jnututa jiryedye, jiidatya jarye risa̱ju̱.
Sapa̱pe̱tyu variy jijyomu, sa̱tidye ju̱pay varirya yivaajyo, sa̱jato varirya rasiy rabajyovimuju̱, raqui̱suy ji̱ta sa̱rupay jiidatya jiryatimyu̱ ne vana̱y ji̱richasarara.”
Jadchiy ji̱ta su̱deda Jesús Cadidéyamusiy, Jurdá̱ja̱ tuudiche, sa̱tidye jtyanutaniy jasiy Juánbayu.
Juánbay rañi ju̱bayada sa̱jisidyerya: “Rañi ji̱ta raryi jtyu̱y yimu. ¿Ta̱raju̱ yiniy variy rimu, ta̱raju̱?”
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variñi̱: “Ne, daryanuma ra̱cha day, daryanuma vurya̱jto̱taniy ti̱ta̱ju̱ Ju̱denu jtedamuju̱ darya.” Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Juánbay variy jtyadodaju̱ni̱ Jesús.
Si̱tyu̱yadanumatiy Jesús, sasipyateda ji̱ta varicha̱ra̱ju̱ ja̱a̱musiy, mityamusiy raseteda jarichu variy, sadiyada ji̱ta siva Ju̱denu Jnutu variy, nu̱tyu ja̱rityude saju̱u̱jeyada variy sivaju̱.
Mityamusiy rara̱yada niquejada jarichuvimusiy variy simuntiy: “Jiñu ji̱ta radyenu jaryi ravya̱tasi̱, jaryi ri̱chana̱tyateni̱.”

footnotes.text: Su̱tarya rasiy yimu tuva̱chuvajyu̱, raqui̱suy ji̱ta su̱tay rijyu̱ jiryatimyu̱ ne rityuva̱churu̱y simu.
